 Raphinha Neymar Barcelona vs Aston Villa Barcelona Aston Villa Champions League Brazil Spain England Raphinha outshines the legends on a night at the Camp Nou
 Raphinha wrote himself into the Barcelona history books with a stunning display against Aston Villa on Tuesday night in the UEFA Champions League.
 The Brazilian struck twice as Barça saw off the English side 3-0 in the fourth round of the league phase.
 His first arrived in the 52nd minute, a strike from the edge of the box. Twelve minutes later he doubled the lead, following up a Joao Cancelo cross to make it 2-0.
 That brace took his season tally to 19 goals and three assists in 13 appearances across all competitions.

 According to statistics from " Mister Chip ", Raphinha now sits top of the list of highest-scoring Brazilians in a Barcelona shirt in the Champions League, with 23 goals.
 He's moved clear of compatriots Rivaldo on 22 and Neymar da Silva on 21.
 The winger also cracked the all-time top 10 of highest-scoring Brazilians in the competition, drawing level with former Liverpool star Roberto Firmino.
 Neymar leads that list with 43 goals for Barcelona and Paris Saint-Germain.
 There was more. Raphinha matched Robert Lewandowski as Barça's third-highest scorer in the Champions League, and he's now just two goals shy of second-placed Luis Suarez. Lionel Messi tops the list with 120.
